leadDispatch.title: PM Balendra Shah Concludes India State Visit with NPR 240B Package, 8 MoUs & Ayodhya–Janakpur Rail Launch
leadDispatch.summary: Prime Minister Balendra Shah and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi adopted the "Viksit Bharat and Samunnat Nepal" Joint Vision at Hyderabad House today, announcing NPR 56 billion in reconstruction grants, NPR 184 billion in energy lines of credit, bidirectional B345 air-route talks, and access to Kandla and Paradip ports.

breakingTicker: PM Balen concludes Delhi visit with NPR 240B package & 8 MoUs

activities.title: PM Balendra Shah & PM Modi Issue Joint Press Release & NPR 240B Package
activities.summary: India announced INR 15,000 crore (NPR 24,000 crore) in development assistance—INR 3,500 crore in grants and INR 11,500 crore in Line of Credit for energy projects.

activities.title: Special Court Summons Former PM Madhav Nepal, Minendra Rijal & 91 Others
activities.summary: Summonses issued for 93 defendants in the NPR 734.9 million land-swap corruption case filed by the CIAA.

activities.title: FNJ Dhulikhel Conference Demands Withdrawal of Press Council Ordinance
activities.summary: FNJ passed a 16-point resolution demanding withdrawal of the Press Council (First Amendment) Ordinance and reinstatement of dismissed state-media journalists.

rumors.title: Airspace Swap Rumor: India Demands Bagdogra Airspace for Bhairahawa
rumors.claim: India is conditioning Bhairahawa air-entry routes on Bagdogra SID airspace.
rumors.verification: Technical proposal on Bagdogra SID reported; B345 route made bidirectional while western routes remain pending.
